metadata.description: Mixed marketing system: Vadim's brand-driven 3DLOOK teams (marketing_vb) blended with Sergiy's marketing specialists (marketing) + the Hermes base. This marketplace ships the bridge plugin (unified /vbsm-campaign + marketing-vb-sm skill); the mix profile also enables the mvb-* and mkt-* plugins, so it is a strict superset of the marketing_vb profile. Execution is delegated to Vadim's live entry points so the mix follows his system instead of drifting from it. Switch into it via profile 'marketing_vb_sm'.

plugins.name: mvb-sm-bridge
plugins.description: Bridge orchestration for the Vadim×Sergiy mix: /vbsm-campaign + the marketing-vb-sm skill — phases, the 28-agent inventory, the two-brand-checker disambiguation, and the precedence rules between the two systems (including the seo-planner content-strategy gate and the per-profile posting rules, which Vadim owns outright)
